free_tier.stated: No total storage cap. Per-upload max 256 GB or 12 hours, whichever is less. Unverified accounts are limited to 15-minute videos; phone verification lifts that.

egress.terms: Free and unmetered — playback and yt-dlp retrieval are served from Google's CDN at no cost; there is no egress meter on the account.

tooling: yt-dlp (youtube extractor, verified present in `yt-dlp --list-extractors`; 1752 extractors total). Binary-in-video: freddiev4/yts3 (FFV1/DCT + fountain codes, 2 stars, pushed 2026-02), KKarmugil/Infinite_Storage_Glitch (188 stars, Python ISG port), karaketir16/file2video (70 stars).
chaining: Unlimited files per channel x unlimited free Google accounts. Each upload is independently 256 GB-capped, so capacity = N accounts x M videos x 256 GB. Upload throughput, not quota, is the binding constraint.
limits_note: A daily upload-count cap exists but Google does not publish the number; its own tier page only distinguishes 'limited daily limit' (unverified) from 'higher daily limit' (phone-verified). The Data API v3 path is capped near 6 uploads/day (~1600 quota units each against a 10,000/day budget). 12-hour duration ceiling means a 256 GB file must average 47 Mbps to be reachable.
